results.content: Gold Fields’ procurement record will be among the issues providing context for the company’s Suppliers Conference 2026, scheduled for October 28 and 29 under the theme, “Partnership for Enduring Value: Building Resilient Supply Chains Beyond Mining.”

results.title: South Africa evacuation: Minority rejects claims they coached returnees
results.content: The Minority in Parliament has denied allegations that it paid or attempted to coach some Ghanaian evacuees from South Africa to speak against the government over the handling of their repatriation and related allowances.

results.title: How Hubtel is rethinking AI in Ghana: Own your data, rent the intelligence
results.content: From the trader at Makola checking prices on her phone to the graduate in Kumasi searching for work, one question is getting louder across Ghana. Will artificial intelligence make life better, or will it take away what people already have? Ghana has placed its bet. In 2025 it launched a ten-year national AI strategy, and government has committed $270 million to get the country ready. But for ordinary Ghanaians, the most useful answers may come from a local company that has already tried, stumbled and found a smarter way forward. That company is Hubtel. Head of Engineering, Augustine Adjei, told the national audience during the premiere of the AI & Ghana’s documentary on Joy News, exactly what Ghana’s AI journey looks like from the inside, and why the country does not need to start big to win.

results.title: Minerals Commission defends termination of Northern Ashanti Mines’ licences over $8.38m debt
results.content: The Minerals Commission has defended its decision to terminate the mining leases and prospecting licences of Northern Ashanti Mines Limited, formerly Ower Mines, citing more than US$8.38 million in unpaid fees and alleged breaches of the Minerals and Mining Act, 2006 (Act 703). In a statement issued on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the Commission said it followed the legally prescribed process after the company failed to settle outstanding Annual Mineral Right (AMR) fees or remedy other breaches identified by the regulator. The company has instituted legal proceedings against the State to challenge the termination, according to the Commission. The Commission said Northern Ashanti Mines acquired a mining lease covering 595 cadastral blocks in January 2010.

results.title: Idris Elba launches free AI filmmaking programme for African creatives
results.content: African creatives in Ghana and four other countries can apply for a free artificial intelligence (AI) filmmaking programme launched by actor Idris Elba’s Akuna Group in partnership with Google.

results.content: A prominent Ghanaian veterinarian is leading a continent-wide campaign against a proposed standard from the African Organisation for Standardisation (ARSO) that would approve battery cages for egg-laying hens.

results.content: The Minority in Parliament has called for an independent investigation into Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs over the controversy surrounding the evacuation of Ghanaians from South Africa.

results.title: Ghana must move from ESG policy commitments to action – Local Government Minister
results.content: The Minister for Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, Mahama Ayariga, has called for stronger institutional coordination, sustainable financing and accountability mechanisms to accelerate the adoption of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) principles across Ghana’s economy.

results.title: GPL 2026/27: ‘I will resign if Samartex engages in match-fixing’ – GM Edmund Ackah
results.content: Speaking in an interview with Asempa FM, the experienced football administrator said he had confidence in the club’s leadership and management.

results.title: Assemblies must lead Ghana’s climate response – Local Government Minister
results.content: The Minister for Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, Mahama Ayariga, has called on Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies (MMDAs) to take a leading role in Ghana’s response to climate change, urging them to translate national commitments into practical results at the community level.

results.title: Agriculture recovery in 2025 was encouraging but uneven, industrial slowdown highlights broader development – ISSER
results.content: In its 2025 State of the Ghana Economy Report (SGER), ISSER said expanding effective irrigation, mechanisation and extension services, with greater attention to crop yields will raise agricultural productivity.

results.title: Samuel Jinapor denies Minority coached South Africa evacuees to criticise government
results.content: Samuel Abdulai Jinapor, the Ranking Member on Parliament’s Foreign Affairs Committee, has dismissed allegations that the Minority in Parliament attempted to influence Ghanaians evacuated from South Africa to speak against the government.

results.title: Kofi Hayford shines as MC of M.anifest’s ‘Nowhere Cool’ at 10 celebration
results.content: Broadcaster Kofi Hayford has earned praise for hosting M.anifest’s 10th anniversary celebration of his acclaimed album Nowhere Cool at the Accra Polo Club on Saturday, 24th October 2026.

results.title: UPSA Banking and Finance students learn to prepare wills as part of financial literacy drive
results.content: Level 400 Banking and Finance students at the University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA), have been guided to write their first wills as part of efforts to promote early estate planning and responsible wealth management among young people.

results.title: ANEG Foundation launches climate awareness and tree-planting project at Amedeka
results.content: The ANEG Foundation has launched a climate awareness and tree-planting initiative at Amedeka, bringing together 35 participants to promote environmental sustainability and encourage young people to take an active role in climate action. The exercise, held on Friday, October 23, 2026, involved climate advocates, Environmental Club students and members of the foundation who planted fruit trees on a designated piece of land. The seedlings included pawpaw, mango, lime and soursop, selected to expand green spaces and promote the environmental benefits of tree planting in local communities. The initiative forms part of the foundation’s efforts to advance climate action, protect the environment and encourage youth participation in building greener and healthier communities.

results.title: Chris Hesse’s film legacy takes centre stage at UniMAC-IFT
results.content: UniMAC-IFT will screen historic footage of Ghana’s independence and early nationhood on 30th October, highlighting veteran cinematographer Rev. Dr Chris Hesse’s efforts to preserve the country’s audiovisual heritage.

results.title: Vice President calls for stronger role for queen mothers in advancing women’s rights
results.content: Vice President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged queen mothers to use their influence to strengthen women’s participation in community decision-making. She said traditional leaders play an important role in advancing gender equality and creating opportunities for women to contribute to community development. The Vice President made the call at the Yokama Ligbi (Ideal Woman Day) celebration, held as part of the 133rd Ngmayem Festival of the Manya Krobo Traditional Area in the Eastern Region. She stressed the need to move beyond policy commitments and ensure that measures designed to empower women translate into tangible improvements in their lives.

results.title: Education Minister commends JoyNews, Manasseh Azure for Obuasi SHTS investigation
results.content: The Education Minister, Haruna Iddrisu, has commended the Multimedia Group Limited and its investigative journalist Manasseh Azure Awuni for their report on the sexual misconduct allegations at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS).

results.title: FC AshantiGold CEO calls for separate Black Stars team for home-based players
results.content: Mr. Akuoko believes Ghana must establish a deliberate system to identify, develop and integrate players from the domestic league into the senior national team to ensure continuity and consistency.

results.title: Ghanaian twins plead guilty in US$9m international romance scam
results.content: Two Ghanaian twin brothers have pleaded guilty in the United States to conspiracy to commit wire fraud in an international romance scam that caused victims to lose more than US$9 million.

results.title: Adu-Boahene case: Court adjourns motion challenging prosecution’s account of evidence to Thursday
results.content: The High Court in Accra on Monday, Monday, October 26, adjourned to Thursday October 29, a motion alleging that the prosecution in the Adu-Boahene trial attributed statements to witnesses which they never made and misrepresented documentary evidence in its written submissions.

results.title: Elevate Africa calls for stronger partnerships to unlock Africa’s development potential
results.content: Elevate Africa has called for stronger connections between the continent’s resources, capital, leadership and opportunities to accelerate development and translate Africa’s potential into tangible results. The call was made at a press conference in Accra ahead of the Elevate Africa Annual Convening 2026, which will be held under the theme “Africa: Defining Her Future.”

results.title: 2026 U17 WWC: Black Maidens eye ‘glory’ after making knockout stages – Adarkwa
results.content: Ghana booked a place in the knockout phase of the competition following a 2-0 win over Canada in their final group game, ensuring they finished second in Group C, where they set up a clash against debutants Argentina.

results.title: Minority demands Ablakwa’s resignation or dismissal over SA evacuation payments
results.content: The Minority in Parliament has called on Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa to resign over allegations that some Ghanaians evacuated from South Africa received less than the GH¢5,500 support package announced by the government.
